## Candidates

## Reviewer checklist

- [ ] Opened every candidate's arXiv page and checked title, authors, and dates against the report.
- [ ] Set each candidate's `decision` in the JSON summary (`accepted`, `rejected`, `deferred`, or `pending`).
- [ ] Confirmed the pull request changes only `docs/daily-collection/`.
- [ ] CI is green.

A daily research pull request is a proposal. A person reviews and merges it; accepted works enter the collection in a separate, evidence-backed change.
